source.title: If-node in sub-workflow causes properties of previous node to become not found when all items go the false path

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body:
### Bug Description

The properties of an earlier node can become not found. This Problem occurs when between the node that sets the property and the node that tries to access it there is a sub-workflow and inside that sub-workflow there is an if-node and all items inside the sub-workflow will go the false path of the if-node.

The error does not occur if all items of the sub-workflow will go the true path or if some items go true and others go false.

Also the property seems to be not found if the expression uses "item" to reference a previous node. When using "first()" or "all()[0]" it seems to work.

Maybe related: When debugging an execution where all items in an if-node use the false path and a merge node is behind it, the merge node is unable to execute.

### To Reproduce

[main-workflow.json](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33341808/main-workflow.json)
[sub-workflow.json](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33341809/sub-workflow.json)

These json files show a main-workflow and a sub-workflow to reproduce this issue. 
If the value properties of all items in the "Set Array Data" nodes myItems field  is true, the workflow works. But if all are set to false the code node at the end will throw an error and in the edit fiels node at the end you can see the difference between the expressions.

### Expected behavior

After the described sub-workflow, nodes should still be able to access earlier nodes via the " $('NameOfEarlyNode').item.json " expression, even if all items used the false path in the subworkflow.
